reason: After inspecting the completed RPE1 results, add a fixed alternative ranking diagnostic and expression-stratum-balanced background. This addresses the earlier diagnostic-comparator gap; it does not select models or optimize scientific results.
scope: Enumerate every original context from original per_target_metrics, retain all factors, two covariate budgets, three thinning seeds, q1 algorithm seeds, five label permutations and fixed anchors. No refitting, changes to targets/genes/folds/B/C, or condition selection.
rank_OLS: Use average midranks of original nonnegative raw scores, without the EDR log floor, and of the current Dc expression. Normalize ranks as (rank-0.5)/G. Take signed OLS residual of score rank on intercept and expression rank. Use the existing residualize numerical constant guard, absolute residual spread <1e-12 for these normalized ranks becomes exact zero. Constant scores give exact zero residual; a constant covariate gives centered ranks. Do not take residual absolute values or break ties by gene ID.
ties: Original fractional boundary-tie inclusion weights: 1 above the exact boundary, 0 below, and equal fractional weights at ties, summing to k. No jitter or identifier tie-breaking.
expression_strata: Compute x=(average_midrank(current_Dc_expression)-0.5)/G. Assign b=min(4,floor(5*x)). All identical expression values remain in the same stratum. Empty strata allowed; no changing bins after results.
matching: For ranking r and stratum b, W_rb=sum(w_rg), H_rb=sum(1-w_rg). If W_rb=0 then v=0. If W_rb>0 and H_rb>=W_rb within 1e-12 numerical tolerance, v_rg=W_rb*(1-w_rg)/H_rb. A capacity deficit greater than 1e-12 makes the whole ranking unsupported; its entire v is NA. Do not relax bins, substitute genes or allow repetition. Keep all support failures and per-stratum masses/capacities/deficits.
matching_balance: Report signed and absolute selected-minus-background expression mean difference and normalized expression-rank mean difference, stratum mass error, total mass error, capacity remaining, and support at both ranking and full-fold level. Coarse balance does not imply exchangeability.
utility: U(t,r)=sum_g w_rg*B_tg*C_tg/k. Matched contrast U_M(t,r)=sum_g (w_rg-v_rg)*B_tg*C_tg/k. Compute own minus mean other rankings in the same original held-out fold. If any source ranking in a fold is unsupported, the matched identity is NA for every target in that fold; never shrink the mismatch source set. Supported own matched utilities may remain available. Constant and same-fold shared rankings must have zero identity up to numerical precision.
null: Also evaluate fixed control-null products under w and w-v for descriptive checks. No permutation p values, exchangeable-null claims, causal interpretation, or calibrated biological claims.
ranking_comparison: For each ranking method compare inclusion weights to its own primary algorithm q1 baseline at the same n and at n400. Do not compute Top50 agreement on signed w-v weights.
contrasts: All factorial C_at_S0, C_at_Sq, model_at_C0, joint and interaction effects; pair every EDR and rank_OLS result with raw and pair rank_OLS with EDR, preserving exact condition and target IDs. Include paired budget n64-n400. Matching may respond to C-only even when raw w is invariant.
aggregation: Per-target/seed records retained. Condition summaries average seeds within targets then targets; fold and seed tables retained. Strict metric means become NA if any required member is NA, with finite counts and support rates reported separately. No silent complete-case inference. No new threshold pass/fail or equivalence claims. Existing fixed empirical-A scale can express unmatched total-utility changes only; matched results use original units.
flags: Record raw all-floor status even for rank_OLS; a ranking of tiny score differences is not recovered information. Record raw/ranking constant flags, unique score count, boundary tie count, fractional-weight count and covariance tie/constant information.
reconstruction_checks: Rebuild all raw and EDR scores/weights and all own/other/identity/null metrics against original saved evaluations and target CSV rows. Require exact Top50 weights and numeric metric differences <=1e-12. Preserve original files/hashes.
interpretation_and_stop: Report all outcomes. Agreement across diagnostics broadens a finite computational observation; EDR-only effects limit it to that transform. Absent useful identity or practical decision rules must be reported, not repaired by selecting another model. This analysis cannot turn the already-read RPE1 data into a new held-out confirmation.
